quotes.quote: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.quote: If we were meant to stay in one place, we'd have roots instead of feet.
quotes.author: Rachel Wolchin

quotes.quote: Adventure isn't hanging on a rope off the side of a mountain. Adventure is an attitude that we must apply to the day to day obstacles in life.
quotes.author: John Amatt

quotes.quote: Wherever you go, go with all your heart.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.quote: Until you step into the unknown, you don't know what you're made of.
quotes.author: Roy T. Bennett

quotes.quote: You can't control the past, but you can control where you go next.
quotes.author: Kirsten Hubbard

quotes.quote: Life isn't about finding yourself. Life is about creating yourself.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw

quotes.quote: It is not the mountain we conquer, but ourselves.
quotes.author: Edmund Hillary

quotes.quote: I am not the same, having seen the moon shine on the other side of the world.
quotes.author: Mary Anne Radmacher

quotes.quote: A mind that is stretched by a new experience can never go back to its old dimensions.
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes

quotes.quote: Life is short and the world is wide.
quotes.author: Simon Raven

quotes.quote: Only those who risk going too far can possibly find out how far they can go.
quotes.author: T.S. Eliot

quotes.quote: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.quote: Travel makes one modest. You see what a tiny place you occupy in the world.
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert

quotes.quote: The real voyage of discovery consists not in seeking new landscapes, but in having new eyes.
quotes.author: Marcel Proust

quotes.quote: Not all those who wander are lost.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien

quotes.quote: To travel is to live.
quotes.author: Hans Christian Andersen

quotes.quote: Jobs fill your pocket, but adventures fill your soul.
quotes.author: Jaime Lyn Beatty

quotes.quote: We travel not to escape life, but for life not to escape us.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.quote: Take only memories, leave only footprints.
quotes.author: Chief Seattle

quotes.quote: Tomorrow is the first blank page of a 365-page book. Write a good one.
quotes.author: Brad Paisley

quotes.quote: The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only one page.
quotes.author: Saint Augustine

quotes.quote: We wander for distraction, but we travel for fulfillment.
quotes.author: Hilaire Belloc

quotes.quote: A journey is best measured in friends, rather than miles.
quotes.author: Tim Cahill

quotes.quote: The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
quotes.author: Audrey Hepburn

quotes.quote: Traveling in the company of those we love is home in motion.
quotes.author: Leigh Hunt

quotes.quote: May the road rise up to meet you. May the wind be always at your back.
quotes.author: Irish Blessing

quotes.quote: There are good ships and wood ships, ships that sail the sea, but the best ships are friendships, and may they always be.
quotes.author: Irish Toast

quotes.quote: Spring is nature's way of saying, 'Let's party!'
quotes.author: Robin Williams

quotes.quote: No winter lasts forever; no spring skips its turn.
quotes.author: Hal Borland

quotes.quote: The earth laughs in flowers.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: In every walk with nature one receives far more than he seeks.
quotes.author: John Muir

quotes.quote: Look deep into nature, and then you will understand everything better.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: The Earth has music for those who listen.
quotes.author: George Santayana

quotes.quote: Live in the sunshine, swim the sea, drink the wild air.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: Summertime is always the best of what might be.
quotes.author: Charles Bowden

quotes.quote: One way to get the most out of life is to act as though everything is a miracle.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Every great adventure begins with someone brave enough to take the first step. Thank you for being part of ours.
quotes.author: Sean Morley

quotes.quote: The best journeys are the ones we share. Happy birthday, AdventureLog — and thank you for logging yours with us.
quotes.author: Sean Morley

quotes.quote: On August 15, 2024, a community of travelers started writing their stories together. Here's to every adventure since — and all the ones still ahead.
quotes.author: Sean Morley

quotes.quote: Tourism is the best way to promote peace and understanding between nations.
quotes.author: Kofi Annan

quotes.quote: Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry, and narrow-mindedness.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: Where there is no imagination there is no horror.
quotes.author: Arthur Conan Doyle

quotes.quote: Every day is Halloween, isn't it? For some of us.
quotes.author: Tim Burton

quotes.quote: The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear, and the oldest and strongest kind of fear is fear of the unknown.
quotes.author: H.P. Lovecraft

quotes.quote: Gratitude turns what we have into enough.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.quote: Feeling gratitude and not expressing it is like wrapping a present and not giving it.
quotes.author: William Arthur Ward

quotes.quote: The more grateful I am, the more beauty I see.
quotes.author: Mary Davis

quotes.quote: In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Winter is not a season, it's a celebration.
quotes.author: Anamika Mishra

quotes.quote: Laughter is the sun that drives winter from the human face.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo

quotes.quote: Christmas waves a magic wand over this world, and behold, everything is softer and more beautiful.
quotes.author: Norman Vincent Peale

quotes.quote: Maybe Christmas doesn't come from a store. Maybe Christmas means a little bit more.
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: Christmas is a season not only of rejoicing but of reflection.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill

quotes.quote: The best way to spread Christmas cheer is singing loud for all to hear.
quotes.author: Buddy the Elf
